customManagers.description: The Rust toolchain is pinned in rust-toolchain.toml (and read from there by CI and the test container); no built-in manager reads its channel.
container/Containerfile installs Chrome with the Playwright CLI at the version of its base image and of @playwright/test; the Dockerfile manager reads the FROM line but not this.

packageRules.description: Digest, pin and pinDigest updates carry no release timestamp (a digest bump of a tag-tracking ref, a range rewritten to the version already in use), so the age gate would hold them forever. Same rule as tauler and pirate-game.
Patch updates are low-review-effort; land them as one PR.

Pinned, not bumped (tauler, PR #597): under `bump` the manifest gets a caret range, and `cargo update` resolves past the version Renovate picked once the age gate holds a newer release back. `=x.y.z` leaves cargo no room. Lockfile maintenance is off (top of file) for the same reason: a whole-lockfile refresh has no release timestamp to age. Transitive security fixes come from `cargo deny check` in ci.yml.
Action digest bumps are independent and noisy; one PR is enough.

takumi re-exports takumi-core types, and this repository builds a patched copy of takumi-svg (vendor/takumi-svg, `[patch.crates-io]`). A takumi bump that needs a newer takumi-svg leaves the patch unused, and the SVG silently loses its data-* annotations (the end-to-end and Playwright tests catch it). So these move together, by hand: copy the new takumi-svg over vendor/, apply vendor/takumi-svg-annotations.patch, then merge (vendor/README.md). The PR opens only when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
The napi-rs CLI generates the binding (index.js, index.d.ts) the napi crates are built for; they move together.

One Playwright version in four places: @playwright/test (the pnpm catalog), the test container's base image, its `playwright install chrome`, and the browsers the tests download. A lone bump makes the installed browsers and the library disagree.
The Rust toolchain moves on its own PR: a new compiler can bring new clippy lints, which CI denies.
